description: The most relevant number of the problem "biased information" of the start page ranking and the potential solution. The concept paper gives no measured figure for how many decisions rest on incomplete or one sided information, so the share is an assumed value; the solution is the Delphi method, a structured and anonymised consultation over several rounds with aggregated feedback.

formulas.name: probability range low
formulas.description: the lower bound of the probability range of an estimate, the estimate multiplied by its low range factor; the centre is the stated target value and each bound is calculated on its own, so that a range can be asymmetric

formulas.name: probability range high
formulas.description: the upper bound of the probability range of an estimate, the estimate multiplied by its high range factor; the centre is the stated target value and each bound is calculated on its own, so that a range can be asymmetric

formulas.name: annual damage in money
formulas.description: the loss that a problem causes each year in money, the world GDP multiplied by the share of it that the problem costs per year

formulas.name: loss reduction by the Delphi method
formulas.description: the share of the potential loss that the solution avoids, the share by which the Delphi method reduces the decisions taken on biased information; the change of the biased decisions is negative, because it is a reduction, while the avoided share of the loss is stated positive

formulas.name: long run damage share of the GDP
formulas.description: the share of the world GDP that a problem costs at the end of its development, the share it costs today multiplied by the factor by which the damage still grows; the share is stated negative, because it is a loss

formulas.name: welfare damage share
formulas.description: the share of the global happy time points that a problem costs, the share of the GDP it costs multiplied by the factor by which the welfare damage exceeds the money damage, because htp counts the healthy life years that the GDP does not (concept paper introduction)

formulas.name: initial effort of a solution
formulas.description: the person years needed to set up a solution, the annual damage of the problem in money multiplied by the effort needed per trillion EUR of damage

formulas.name: avoided welfare loss with a gain factor
formulas.description: the happy time points that a solution saves, like the avoided welfare loss, but multiplied by a factor of the problem, because the shared world htp is tuned to one problem and does not fit the others until the horizon of the ranking is stated; the result is stated positive, because it is a gain

formulas.name: loss reduction of a solution part
formulas.description: the share of the potential loss of a problem that one part of its solution avoids, the share of the loss it avoids if it is fully in place multiplied by the probability that it is fully in place; the same measure as the loss reduction of the whole solution in the start page ranking

formulas.name: initial effort of a solution part
formulas.description: the person years needed to set up one part of a solution, its cost in billion USD multiplied by the person years per billion USD

sources.name: Linstone & Turoff (1975) Delphi method
